environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x runtime) deployed behind API Gateway HTTP API (v2) with no additional request validation. The Lambda is in a VPC with access to internal backend services on port 8080. The function execution role has AmazonVPCFullAccess and the Lambda runs with default Lambda execution environment (Amazon Linux 2, no custom security profiles). The API Gateway passes all headers including Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length without normalization. Backend is nginx/1.21 which processes pipelined requests.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API v2, no request validation
config.backend: nginx/1.21 with proxy_pass to upstream app
